name: CriminalZ
detailed_description:
CriminalZ

CriminalZ is a rogue-lite co-op action game where you and your gang must survive the criminal underworld—while being hunted by the police, stalked by rival gangs, and exploited by your own ruthless boss.

Your mission? Earn dirty money fast.
Your deadline? Pay the quota... or face the consequences.

Play your role—or play them all.

In CriminalZ, your equipment defines your role. Build your own criminal style with specialized tools:

  • Pickpocket – Silent, agile, and built for quick scores.

  • Burglar – Breach locked doors and loot the best stashes.

  • Hacker – Disable cameras and unlock digital gates remotely.

  • Woosh Dealer – Risk high attention for high reward.

Swap tools. Adapt strategies. Every run is different.

Strategy meets chaos.

Each session starts from scratch. You scavenge trash, make small money, buy tools—and then dive into the real action.

  • Procedurally generated interiors offer unique layouts and challenges.

  • Gems are the permanent currency for upgrading and evolving your character.

  • Permadeath keeps you on edge, but rogue-lite progression lets you come back stronger.

You're never safe.

There’s no "safehouse" once the timer starts:

  • Cops respond to every crime

  • Rival criminals hunt you at night

  • Difficulty scales the longer you survive

And if you don't pay the boss in time... let’s just say, it won’t end well.

Build your gang. Build your legacy.

Form or join a gang. Pool gems together to unlock permanent upgrades:

  • Inventory expansions

  • Buffs to pickpocketing, stealth, and combat

  • Passive income and shared progress

Level up your gang and climb the leaderboards to prove your squad runs the city.

 Key Features

  •  1–4 player online co-op (Listen server based)

  •  Rogue-lite structure with persistent upgrades

  •  Skill-based movement, interiors, and stealth

  • Deep progression with items, stats, and skill trees

  • Built-in voice chat and Steam friends support

  • Immersive urban sandbox with evolving cities

CriminalZ is your ticket to chaos, camaraderie, and crime.
Do you have what it takes to rise—or will you fold under pressure?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for optimal performance

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains stylized violence, criminal activity, drug references, and strong language. Not suitable for all ages.
Players may encounter depictions of illegal acts such as theft, drug dealing, and police chases. The tone may include dark humor and toxic interactions.
